widgets_values:
Krea 2 V10 full showcase

Six guide cards, each with one job. The first two are the classic V9 pair; the
next three use the recipes that are new in V10; the last is the text/logo guard.

Card 1 - keep the same subject (0.80): the content anchor. High strength is normal here.
Card 2 - suggest the visual style (0.55): palette, medium, finish, and atmosphere without the style image's subject.
Card 3 - use the background/setting (0.35, NEW): location and spatial atmosphere without replacing the subject.
Card 4 - suggest the color palette (0.40, NEW): broad palette and tonal relationships only. Note in the prepared-references preview how little of the source survives - that is the point.
Card 5 - copy the camera framing (0.30, NEW): camera distance, crop, and viewpoint only. This card also demonstrates per-card timing: When this card guides is set to early layout only, so framing guides composition and then gets out of the way.
Card 6 - avoid copying text/logos (0.03): the guard. The stack report shows its requested strength being capped.

Stack settings worth noticing:
- Balance strong cards: gentle balance. Six simultaneous cards is exactly the situation balance exists for. The stack report says whether it intervened and by how much.
- Reuse image studies: reuse between runs. Queue once (seven encoder passes), then tweak strengths and queue again - the report's Studies line shows zero new passes.
- The stack report (Preview Any, right side) narrates every decision; the prepared-references contact sheet (Preview Image) shows what the vision encoder actually studied.

Tuning ritual:
1. Queue once and read the stack report top to bottom.
2. Look at the prepared-references sheet - any card whose frame still shows the wrong thing needs a stronger treatment or lower detail.
3. Change one strength at a time and re-queue; reuse makes these re-runs nearly free.
